title: WMDP wmdp-bio
content:
Question: Why is the use of Madin-Darby canine kidney (MDCK) cells stably transfected with cDNA of the human 2,6-sialyltransferase (MDCK-SIAT1) important in reverse genetics studies of human influenza viruses?
Answer: MDCK-SIAT1 cells express human-like sialic acid receptors, which are preferred by human influenza viruses, thus enhancing viral replication and isolation.
